start_gate_note: HB-TRAIN-SOLO-WINDOW (a): `merge_train.ps1 -Gate` exits 0 (START) at min_rows queued rows or once the oldest queued row has waited max_wait_min minutes, else 3 (WAIT). -Override starts anyway. enabled=false makes -Gate always START. The L0 conductor calls it before a pass or -Drain.
priority_scope_note: HB-TRAIN-SOLO-WINDOW (b): 'games' = the mashed_lock priority hold starts after merge, archive/tracker lint, build and lint_rva_bodies, right before the game legs (G-CTRL, B, 13 tracks, D2). 'pass' = old behaviour, hold from before the first merge. Gate content is unchanged either way (L-138).
text_only_unless_built_note: HB-TRAIN-MATCH-TEXTONLY 2026-11-10: a changed file under these roots is text-only unless the build reads it (listed in mashedmod/exe_sources.rsp or asi_sources.rsp, or #included from a mashedmod source, followed through includes inside the root; a build script naming re/match makes every file a build input). merge_train.ps1 Get-BuildMatchRefs.
conflict_keyed_note: HB-TRACKER-AT-MERGE: 3-way merge by key (re/tools/tracker_merge3.py) before the halt check; a key edited differently on both sides still sets the branch aside. Promotion rows commit re/promotions/<ID>.tsv instead and the train applies it (merge_train.ps1 Apply-Promotions).
conflict_halt_note: every other conflicted file halts the branch (frida-sweep SKILL.md:61-64,107); hooks_registry.py, STUBS.md, UNCERTAINTIES.md are resolved by hand (hooks.csv only when the same RVA is edited on both sides)
